day_by_day.morning: No activities — flight arrives late at night
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities — flight arrives late at night
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Orlando International Airport at 22:30 via United Airlines. Take Disney's free Magical Express shuttle or a budget rideshare (Lyft/Uber ~$25-35) to Aegean Bliss Resort at Disney World. Check in, unpack essentials, and review your park tickets and plans for the week. Grab a light snack from the resort's convenience store or vending machines.

meals.breakfast: On the plane or at the airport before boarding
meals.lunch: On the plane or at the airport
meals.dinner: Resort convenience store snacks or a quick grab-and-go item from the resort lobby (~$5-10). Consider packing snacks in your luggage to save money on arrival night.

day_by_day.notes: Since arrival is at 22:30, keep Day 1 simple. Confirm your resort check-in details in advance. Download the My Disney Experience app before landing to manage park reservations and Lightning Lane selections. Get a good night's rest — big days ahead!

day_by_day.morning: Start early with a resort breakfast, then head to Magic Kingdom — the most iconic Disney park. Arrive at rope drop (park typically opens at 9:00 AM) to beat the crowds. Prioritize top rides: Space Mountain, Big Thunder Mountain Railroad, and the Haunted Mansion. Use the free Disney Lightning Lane tip: ride standby on lower-wait attractions first thing in the morning.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Fantasyland and Tomorrowland. Catch the Festival of Fantasy Parade (check the app for timing, usually early afternoon). Grab a budget-friendly lunch at Cosmic Ray's Starlight Café or Columbia Harbour House — counter service keeps costs down. Explore Liberty Square and Adventureland. Ride Pirates of the Caribbean and the Jungle Cruise.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the Magic Kingdom Fireworks show (EPCOT Forever or Happily Ever After — check the 2027 schedule on the app). This is included with park admission and is a must-see. Head back to the resort via Disney's free bus transportation. Wind down with snacks from your room stash.

meals.breakfast: Resort food court or bring your own cereal/granola bars to the room (~$5-8 per person). Consider a quick-service breakfast at the resort.
meals.lunch: Cosmic Ray's Starlight Café inside Magic Kingdom — burgers, chicken, and salads (~$12-15 per person)
meals.dinner: Casey's Corner hot dogs or grab a counter-service meal before the fireworks (~$10-14 per person). Eat before peak dinner hours to avoid long waits.

day_by_day.notes: Magic Kingdom is best experienced with an early start. Use the My Disney Experience app to check wait times in real time. Bring refillable water bottles — free water is available at quick-service locations. Wear comfortable shoes and apply sunscreen generously. June weather in Orlando is hot and humid (highs ~90°F/32°C) with afternoon thunderstorms likely.

day_by_day.morning: Head to EPCOT at rope drop. Start in Future World (now called World Discovery and World Nature) — ride Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind (virtual queue — grab a boarding pass on the app the moment the park opens), Test Track, and Soarin' Around the World. These are the most popular rides, so tackle them first.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the World Showcase, which opens at 11:00 AM. Walk around the 11 country pavilions — this is essentially free cultural sightseeing included with your ticket. Sample budget-friendly international snacks like a croissant from France (~$5), school bread from Norway (~$5), or a spring roll from China (~$4-6). These small bites let you 'eat around the world' without spending on full meals.
day_by_day.evening: Catch the EPCOT nighttime spectacular (check 2027 schedule — likely a fireworks/projection show over World Showcase Lagoon). This is free with admission and absolutely stunning. Take the Disney Skyliner gondola back toward the resort area — it's free, scenic, and a fun experience in itself.

meals.breakfast: Bring your own breakfast from the resort or grab a quick bite at the resort food court (~$6-10)
meals.lunch: Snack your way around World Showcase — budget $15-20 for several small international bites instead of one sit-down meal
meals.dinner: Sunshine Seasons in The Land pavilion — one of EPCOT's best value quick-service spots with fresh, varied options (~$13-16 per person)

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT is a large park — comfortable walking shoes are essential. The Guardians of the Galaxy ride requires a virtual queue boarding pass, so have the app ready at exactly 7:00 AM and again at 1:00 PM when a second wave releases. The World Showcase is great for families — each pavilion has free cultural exhibits, movies, and entertainment.

day_by_day.morning: Take a well-earned morning off from the parks. Sleep in and enjoy a leisurely resort breakfast. Spend the morning at the Aegean Bliss Resort pool — a great way to cool off in the Florida heat without spending extra money. This rest day helps recharge energy for the remaining park days.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit Disney Springs — Disney's free shopping, dining, and entertainment district (no park ticket required). Browse the shops, watch street performers, and enjoy the atmosphere. Visit the LEGO Store (free to browse and play at the LEGO build tables), check out the Disney Style store, and walk along the waterfront. If budget allows, catch a movie at the AMC Disney Springs theater.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy dinner at Disney Springs with budget-friendly options. Walk around after dinner and enjoy the free live music and entertainment on the waterfront stages. Return to the resort early for a full night's rest before Hollywood Studios day.

meals.breakfast: Resort food court — pancakes, eggs, or continental options (~$8-12 per person)
meals.lunch: Pack sandwiches or snacks from the resort to enjoy poolside — saves significant money on a rest day
meals.dinner: Disney Springs: Blaze Fast-Fire'd Pizza (~$10-13 per person) or Earl of Sandwich (~$9-12 per person) — both are excellent budget options with generous portions

day_by_day.notes: Disney Springs is completely free to enter and explore — no park ticket needed. Parking is also free. This is a great budget-friendly day that still feels very Disney. The pool at Aegean Bliss Resort is a perfect way to enjoy the Florida sunshine. Stay hydrated throughout the day — June heat is intense.

day_by_day.morning: Head to Hollywood Studios at rope drop. This park is home to some of Disney's most thrilling experiences. Priority rides at opening: Rise of the Resistance (Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge) — join the virtual queue or Individual Lightning Lane at park open. Then ride Slinky Dog Dash and Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run before lines build up.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge — browse the Marketplace, look at custom lightsabers and droids (window shopping is free!), and enjoy the immersive theming. Head to Toy Story Land for Alien Swirling Saucers and the Toy Story Mania ride. Catch the Indiana Jones Epic Stunt Spectacular show (free with admission, check times on the app).
day_by_day.evening: End the day with the Star Wars: A Galactic Spectacular nighttime show (fireworks and projections — check 2027 schedule). This is one of the most impressive nighttime shows at Disney World and is included with park admission. Head back to the resort via Disney bus.

meals.breakfast: Quick resort breakfast or granola bars on the go (~$5-8)
meals.lunch: Woody's Lunch Box in Toy Story Land — one of Hollywood Studios' best budget spots. Totchos (tater tot nachos) and grilled cheese sandwiches (~$10-13 per person)
meals.dinner: ABC Commissary — a large counter-service restaurant with varied menu options and typically shorter waits (~$12-15 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Hollywood Studios gets very crowded, especially in summer. Rope drop is critical here. Rise of the Resistance is the #1 must-do — the virtual queue fills up in seconds, so be on the app at exactly park open time. Bring ponchos — afternoon thunderstorms are common in June and ponchos from a dollar store are much cheaper than Disney-branded ones.

day_by_day.morning: Spend the morning at Animal Kingdom — Disney's nature and adventure-themed park. Arrive at rope drop and head straight to Avatar Flight of Passage in Pandora: The World of Avatar (the most popular ride in the park — waits can exceed 2 hours midday). Follow up with Na'vi River Journey nearby.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Africa and Asia sections of the park. Ride Kilimanjaro Safaris in the morning or early afternoon for the best animal activity (animals are more active when it's cooler). Watch the Finding Nemo: The Big Blue... and Beyond! show at the Theater in the Wild (free with admission, air-conditioned — a great midday break from the heat). Explore the Maharajah Jungle Trek and Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail — both are free walking trails with incredible wildlife viewing.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the Tree of Life Awakenings — a beautiful free light projection show on the iconic Tree of Life that runs after dark at various intervals. Enjoy the Rivers of Light area ambiance. Head back to the resort for a relaxed final evening before the last park day.

meals.breakfast: Grab-and-go from the resort or pack snacks (~$5-8)
meals.lunch: Flame Tree Barbecue — one of the best quick-service meals in all of Disney World. BBQ ribs, chicken, and brisket with a beautiful outdoor waterfront seating area (~$14-17 per person)
meals.dinner: Satu'li Canteen in Pandora — bowls with rice, protein, and fresh toppings. Healthy, filling, and reasonably priced for Disney (~$13-16 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Animal Kingdom closes earlier than other parks — check the 2027 schedule. The park is best experienced in the morning and late afternoon when animals are most active and temperatures are slightly cooler. Bring bug spray for the outdoor trails. The safari is a highlight for families — animals roam freely in large, naturalistic habitats.

day_by_day.morning: Return to your favorite park for a final morning — Magic Kingdom or EPCOT are great choices for a relaxed last day. Use this morning to revisit any rides you missed or loved most. Pick up any last souvenirs — Disney Springs (visited on Day 4) is the most budget-friendly place to buy Disney merchandise, or check the resort gift shop for clearance items.
day_by_day.afternoon: Check out of Aegean Bliss Resort (confirm checkout time at the front desk — typically 11:00 AM). Store your luggage at the resort's bell services desk and enjoy a few more hours at Disney Springs or the resort pool. Do a final stroll through Disney Springs for any last-minute shopping or a farewell treat — a Mickey ice cream bar (~$5-6) is a classic Disney send-off.
day_by_day.evening: Arrange your transportation to Orlando International Airport. Book a rideshare (Lyft/Uber ~$25-35) or Disney's transportation options well in advance. Arrive at the airport at least 2-2.5 hours before your departure flight. Reflect on an incredible week of Disney magic!

meals.breakfast: Final resort breakfast — treat yourself to a slightly nicer option as a farewell meal (~$10-15 per person)
meals.lunch: Quick bite at Disney Springs or the park — Chicken Guy!, Earl of Sandwich, or a food cart snack (~$10-13 per person)
meals.dinner: Airport dining or pack snacks for the journey home to save on expensive airport food

day_by_day.notes: Confirm your flight details and airport transportation the night before. Disney's Magical Express (or equivalent 2027 service) may offer complimentary airport transfers — check with your resort. Take photos at your favorite spots one last time. The My Disney Experience app lets you download PhotoPass photos if you had pictures taken throughout the week — check for any bundle deals before your account resets after your trip.

day_by_day.morning: No activities — flight arrives late night
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities — flight arrives late night
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Orlando International Airport at 22:30 via Flight UA. Collect luggage, arrange resort transportation or pre-booked Magical Express/rideshare to Aegean Bliss Resort at Disney World. Check in, settle into your Beachfront room, and do a quick unpack.

meals.breakfast: On the plane or at the airport before departure
meals.lunch: On the plane or airport layover meal
meals.dinner: Grab a light late-night bite at the resort's lobby bar or a 24-hour quick-service option on property — try a sandwich, wrap, or snack platter to keep it simple after a long travel day

day_by_day.notes: Keep Day 1 stress-free. Pre-order groceries or snacks via Instacart/Amazon Fresh to your resort for the week. Confirm all Disney park reservations and download the My Disney Experience app before sleeping. Rest up — the magic starts tomorrow!

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and enjoy a leisurely resort breakfast. Take time to explore the Aegean Bliss Resort grounds — stroll the beachfront area, check out the pool, and get your bearings. Visit the resort's concierge to confirm park tickets, Lightning Lane passes, and transportation schedules for the week.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head to Disney Springs for a relaxed, no-ticket-required afternoon. Browse the unique shops, explore the LEGO store, check out the Disney flagship store, and enjoy the waterfront atmosphere. This is a perfect low-key way to ease into the Disney experience without park crowds.
day_by_day.evening: Disney Springs Dining & Entertainment Evening — Enjoy live street entertainment, browse the remaining shops, and soak in the vibrant atmosphere. Watch the evening entertainment and enjoy the illuminated waterfront before heading back to the resort.

meals.breakfast: Resort buffet breakfast at Aegean Bliss Resort — fuel up for the day ahead
meals.lunch: Disney Springs: Blaze Fast-Fire'd Pizza or Earl of Sandwich for a mid-range, casual, and satisfying meal
meals.dinner: Disney Springs: The BOATHOUSE — enjoy waterfront dining with American classics like burgers, seafood, and steaks. Mid-range pricing with a great atmosphere for families

day_by_day.notes: Disney Springs is free to enter — no park ticket needed. This is a great recovery day after late arrival. Pick up any forgotten toiletries or Disney merchandise here. Confirm park reservations for the rest of the week using the My Disney Experience app tonight.

day_by_day.morning: Magic Kingdom Park Full Day — Arrive at rope drop (park opening, typically 9:00 AM) to beat the crowds. Head straight to Tomorrowland for Space Mountain, then move to Fantasyland for Seven Dwarfs Mine Train using Lightning Lane if pre-booked. Explore Peter Pan's Flight, It's a Small World, and the Haunted Mansion in the late morning.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue Magic Kingdom exploration — enjoy Pirates of the Caribbean, Big Thunder Mountain Railroad, and Liberty Square Riverboat. Take a mid-afternoon break during peak heat hours (2–4 PM) at a shaded spot or a sit-down restaurant inside the park. Use this time for character meet-and-greets or catching the afternoon parade.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the Magic Kingdom nighttime spectacular — the iconic Happily Ever After fireworks show (check schedule) and the Main Street Electrical Parade if running. These evening shows are the crown jewel of Magic Kingdom and absolutely worth staying for. Depart after the fireworks crowd disperses.

meals.breakfast: Quick breakfast at the resort before rope drop — grab a grab-and-go item from the resort's quick-service or a pre-packed snack
meals.lunch: Columbia Harbour House in Liberty Square — mid-range counter service with clam chowder, fried fish, and chicken strips in a charming setting
meals.dinner: Be Our Guest Restaurant in Fantasyland — a beloved mid-range dining experience inside the Beast's Castle with French-inspired cuisine. Book in advance via My Disney Experience

day_by_day.notes: Arrive 30 minutes before official park opening for the best experience. Use Lightning Lane Multi Pass for top attractions. Wear comfortable shoes and bring sunscreen, a refillable water bottle, and light rain gear. June weather in Orlando can bring afternoon thunderstorms — plan indoor attractions during any rain bursts.

day_by_day.morning: EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour — Arrive at EPCOT for opening and head to Future World/World Discovery first. Experience Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind and Test Track early before lines build. Then transition into World Showcase as it opens around 11:00 AM, starting with Mexico and working your way around the lagoon.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue the World Showcase loop — explore the pavilions of Norway (Frozen Ever After ride), China (stunning 360° film), Italy, America, Japan, and France. Stop for cultural exhibits, artisan demonstrations, and unique pavilion-specific experiences. Catch a live cultural performance if scheduled on the World Showcase stage.
day_by_day.evening: End the EPCOT day with the breathtaking EPCOT Forever or Harmonious nighttime lagoon spectacular (check current show schedule). Watch from the World Showcase promenade for the best views. This is one of Disney's most stunning nighttime shows.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast — light and early to maximize park time
meals.lunch: EPCOT World Showcase food stalls — this IS the experience! Sample 3–4 small dishes from different countries: a crepe from France, sushi from Japan, tacos from Mexico, and a School Bread from Norway. Budget around $30–40 per person for a satisfying food tour lunch
meals.dinner: Teppan Edo in the Japan Pavilion — mid-range hibachi-style dinner with tableside cooking, great for families and a memorable cultural dining experience. Reserve in advance

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT is massive — wear the most comfortable shoes you own. The World Showcase food tour is a highlight of any Disney trip and a great way to experience global cuisine without a formal restaurant reservation at lunch. Check the EPCOT app for live entertainment schedules throughout the day.

day_by_day.morning: Hollywood Studios Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Adventure — Arrive at rope drop for Hollywood Studios. Head directly to Galaxy's Edge (Land of Batuu) first thing in the morning. Experience Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run immediately, then queue or use Lightning Lane for Rise of the Resistance — one of the most immersive theme park experiences ever created.
day_by_day.afternoon: If the family is interested, visit Savi's Workshop to build a custom lightsaber (additional cost, ~$249.99 — optional splurge for Star Wars fans) or Droid Depot to build a custom droid (~$119.99). Explore the Oga's Cantina for a unique mid-afternoon drink break (reservations recommended). Then venture to other Hollywood Studios areas — Toy Story Land for Slinky Dog Dash, and the Tower of Terror.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the Hollywood Studios nighttime experience — Fantasmic! (check if running) is an incredible outdoor water, fire, and projection show. Also experience the Star Wars: A Galactic Spectacular fireworks if scheduled. These evening shows make the late park stay very worthwhile.

meals.breakfast: Grab-and-go from resort or a quick-service breakfast inside Hollywood Studios at Backlot Express
meals.lunch: Docking Bay 7 Food and Cargo in Galaxy's Edge — mid-range Star Wars-themed quick service with creative dishes like Smoked Kaadu Ribs and Fried Endorian Tip-Yip (chicken). Fully themed and delicious
meals.dinner: 50's Prime Time Café at Hollywood Studios — a fun, nostalgic mid-range diner experience with comfort food classics like pot roast, meatloaf, and milkshakes. Great family atmosphere with interactive servers

day_by_day.notes: Rise of the Resistance is the most in-demand attraction at Disney World — use Lightning Lane Individual Attraction purchase at 7:00 AM sharp if available, or join the virtual queue immediately at park open. Galaxy's Edge is best experienced in the morning before crowds peak. Lightsaber building is a premium experience but creates lasting memories.

day_by_day.morning: Animal Kingdom Kilimanjaro Safaris & Avatar Experience — Arrive at Animal Kingdom at rope drop. Head immediately to Kilimanjaro Safaris for the best wildlife viewing — animals are most active in the cool morning hours. You may spot giraffes, elephants, lions, hippos, and rhinos up close. Follow up with the Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail for a walking wildlife experience.
day_by_day.afternoon: Journey to Pandora — The World of Avatar for the afternoon. Experience Avatar Flight of Passage (use Lightning Lane — this is the park's most popular ride) for a breathtaking banshee flying simulation, and Na'vi River Journey for a gentler, beautifully immersive experience. Explore the bioluminescent landscape of Pandora which glows differently in different light. Also catch a live cultural performance at the Africa or Asia stage.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the Rivers of Light nighttime show if running, or enjoy the Tree of Life Awakenings — a stunning projection show on the Tree of Life that runs throughout the evening. Animal Kingdom typically closes earlier than other parks, so plan to return to the resort for a relaxed resort evening at the pool or beachfront.

meals.breakfast: Early resort breakfast — light meal before the safari
meals.lunch: Satu'li Canteen in Pandora — mid-range quick service with healthy, flavorful bowls featuring grains, proteins, and unique sauces. One of the best quick-service options in all of Disney World
meals.dinner: Tiffins Restaurant at Animal Kingdom — a mid-to-upper-range table service restaurant with globally inspired cuisine and stunning art celebrating world exploration. A more elevated dinner experience to mark a wonderful park day

day_by_day.notes: Animal Kingdom is best experienced with an early start — wildlife and cooler temperatures make mornings magical. Avatar Flight of Passage is a must-do but has long waits; Lightning Lane is strongly recommended. The park often closes by 8–9 PM, making this a good evening for a resort pool session or early bedtime before the final full park day.

day_by_day.morning: Revisit your favorite park or use this day to catch any missed experiences. Recommended: Return to Magic Kingdom for any rides you missed, or spend a final morning at EPCOT's Future World attractions (Spaceship Earth, Living with the Land, The Seas with Nemo). Alternatively, enjoy a relaxed final morning at the Aegean Bliss Resort — swim at the beachfront, enjoy a resort spa treatment, or take a leisurely walk along the waterfront.
day_by_day.afternoon: Resort relaxation afternoon — spend quality time at the Aegean Bliss Resort pool and beachfront area. This is a perfect time to decompress, let the kids splash around, and soak in the Florida sunshine. Do any last-minute souvenir shopping at the resort gift shop or take a quick trip to Disney Springs for final purchases.
day_by_day.evening: Farewell Disney Springs Dinner — return to Disney Springs for a final celebratory dinner. Browse any last shops, enjoy live entertainment, and take a final stroll along the waterfront to close out a magical week. Return to the resort, begin packing, and reminisce about the week's highlights.

meals.breakfast: Full resort breakfast — treat yourselves to a proper sit-down breakfast on the final morning to celebrate the trip
meals.lunch: Resort pool bar and grill — enjoy casual burgers, sandwiches, and tropical drinks poolside for a relaxed midday meal
meals.dinner: Disney Springs: STK Orlando or Paddlefish — mid-to-upper-range celebratory farewell dinner. STK offers modern steakhouse fare in a lively atmosphere; Paddlefish is a stunning riverboat restaurant with great seafood. Both are perfect for a memorable final night

day_by_day.notes: Check resort checkout time and arrange transportation to the airport in advance if departing the next morning. Leave packing for after the farewell dinner. Take photos at the resort's beachfront for lasting memories. Confirm return flight details and set an early alarm if needed. Consider purchasing Disney PhotoPass downloads if you used Memory Maker throughout the week.

Check in to your Beachfront suite, enjoy a welcome amenity and champagne turndown service. Take a leisurely stroll along the resort grounds or unwind at the adults-only rooftop pool bar before retiring.

meals.lunch: Not applicable (travel day)
meals.dinner: Late-night in-room dining from the resort's 24-hour premium room service menu — recommended: charcuterie board, lobster bisque, and a bottle of Whispering Angel rosé to celebrate your arrival

day_by_day.notes: Pre-arrange a private airport transfer (e.g., Uber Black or resort concierge car service) for a seamless arrival. Request early check-in confirmation and a suite upgrade through the concierge ahead of time. Keep the first night light — park days begin tomorrow.

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and enjoy a leisurely resort breakfast. After fueling up, head to Magic Kingdom for a full-day experience. Arrive at park opening (typically 9:00 AM) using your Disney Lightning Lane Premier Pass to skip standby queues entirely. Begin with iconic classics: Space Mountain, Haunted Mansion, and Pirates of the Caribbean. Explore Fantasyland with younger family members and capture photos in front of Cinderella Castle.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue your Magic Kingdom adventure through the afternoon. Ride Big Thunder Mountain Railroad and Tomorrowland Speedway, then catch the Festival of Fantasy Parade (typically 3:00 PM). Cool off with a Dole Whip at Aloha Isle. Use Lightning Lane to experience Seven Dwarfs Mine Train — one of the park's most sought-after attractions. Take a mid-afternoon break at a shaded seating area or retreat to a private VIP lounge if booked through Disney's VIP Tour Services.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the breathtaking Disney Enchantment nighttime spectacular and the Main Street Electrical Parade. Secure a premium reserved viewing spot through your VIP tour guide. After the fireworks, exit the park and enjoy a relaxing dinner at a nearby upscale resort restaurant before returning to Aegean Bliss.

meals.breakfast: Citricos or the resort's signature breakfast restaurant — enjoy eggs benedict, fresh-pressed juices, and a pastry basket in an elegant setting
meals.lunch: Be Our Guest Restaurant inside Magic Kingdom (Beast's Castle) — prix-fixe lunch with French-inspired dishes including braised pork and grey stuff dessert; advance dining reservation essential
meals.dinner: California Grill atop Disney's Contemporary Resort — panoramic views of Magic Kingdom fireworks, sushi, wood-fired flatbreads, and an award-winning wine list; request a window table when booking

day_by_day.notes: Book Disney Lightning Lane Premier Pass as early as 7:00 AM on the day of your visit via the My Disney Experience app. Advance Dining Reservations (ADRs) for Be Our Guest and California Grill should be made 60 days in advance. Consider booking a Disney VIP Tour (private guided experience) for the ultimate hassle-free Magic Kingdom day.

day_by_day.morning: Head to EPCOT for the World Showcase Food & Culture Tour. Arrive when the park opens and begin in Future World with Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind (virtual queue or Lightning Lane required) and Remy's Ratatouille Adventure. Then make your way to the World Showcase Lagoon as it opens at 11:00 AM, beginning your international culinary and cultural journey in Mexico at La Cava del Tequila.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue the EPCOT World Showcase tour through the afternoon pavilions — Norway (try the School Bread at Kringla Bakeri), China (acrobat performances), Italy, Japan (sake tasting at Mitsukoshi), and Morocco. Participate in the premium EPCOT International Food & Wine Festival experiences if running during your visit. Enjoy curated food and beverage pairings, cooking demonstrations by celebrity chefs, and exclusive Signature Dining events. Use Lightning Lane for Test Track and Soarin' Around the World.
day_by_day.evening: Wind down your EPCOT evening with the stunning EPCOT Forever or Harmonious nighttime lagoon spectacular — one of the largest fireworks shows in Disney history. Secure a premium lagoon-side viewing location. After the show, enjoy a sophisticated dinner at one of EPCOT's Signature restaurants before heading back to the resort.

meals.breakfast: In-room butler breakfast at Aegean Bliss Resort — fresh fruit platter, smoked salmon bagels, and specialty coffee service delivered to your beachfront suite balcony
meals.lunch: Spice Road Table, EPCOT Morocco Pavilion — Mediterranean small plates, hummus, lamb kofta, and sangria with a stunning lagoon view
meals.dinner: Monsieur Paul, EPCOT France Pavilion — Michelin-inspired French haute cuisine; prix-fixe menu featuring foie gras, duck confit, and soufflé; one of Walt Disney World's most elegant dining experiences

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT's World Showcase doesn't fully open until 11:00 AM, so plan Future World rides for the morning. If the EPCOT International Food & Wine Festival is active in June, purchase the Discovery Sampler lanyard for curated tastings across all pavilions. La Cava del Tequila is walk-up only — arrive early or expect a wait.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a relaxed morning at Aegean Bliss Resort — take advantage of the beachfront amenities, spa, or resort pool before heading out. Check in for a premium spa treatment (deep tissue massage or couples' ritual) to recharge mid-trip. This serves as a well-deserved rest morning before an exciting afternoon and evening at Hollywood Studios.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Hollywood Studios for the Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Adventure. Begin with Rise of the Resistance (Lightning Lane essential — one of Disney's most immersive ride experiences ever created). Then head to Oga's Cantina for exotic cocktails and Star Wars ambiance. Book your Savi's Workshop Lightsaber Building experience (reservations required, ~$299 per lightsaber) — a deeply personal and theatrical 20-minute ceremony your family will treasure forever. Explore Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run and the full Batuu marketplace.
day_by_day.evening: Stay at Hollywood Studios for the spectacular Fantasmic! nighttime show — arrive 45 minutes early for premium reserved seating (Fantasmic! Dining Package recommended). Afterwards, catch the Star Wars: A Galactic Spectacular fireworks and projection show over the Chinese Theatre. Return to the resort for a nightcap at the rooftop bar.

meals.breakfast: Aegean Bliss Resort spa café or poolside brunch — avocado toast, acai bowls, and fresh smoothies in a relaxed open-air setting
meals.lunch: Docking Bay 7 Food and Cargo, Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge — thematic and surprisingly excellent quick-service; try the Felucian Garden Spread (plant-based) or Smoked Kaadu Ribs; pair with a Meiloorun Juice or Blue Milk
meals.dinner: Sci-Fi Dine-In Theater Restaurant, Hollywood Studios — retro drive-in cinema dining experience with classic American fare; enjoy burgers, steaks, and milkshakes under a starlit indoor sky; book the Fantasmic! Dining Package for guaranteed show seating

day_by_day.notes: Savi's Workshop reservations fill up months in advance — book the moment your 60-day ADR window opens. The Lightsaber Building experience is $299 per saber and is one of the most memorable premium experiences at Disney. Rise of the Resistance Lightning Lane should be purchased the moment the park opens at 7:00 AM. The Fantasmic! Dining Package must be reserved separately and includes a voucher for reserved show seating.

day_by_day.morning: Head to Disney's Animal Kingdom for the Kilimanjaro Safaris & Avatar Experience. Arrive at rope drop (typically 8:00 AM) to experience Kilimanjaro Safaris in the cool morning hours when animals are most active. Your open-air safari vehicle will traverse 110 acres of authentic African savanna — spot free-roaming giraffes, elephants, lions, zebras, and hippos up close. Follow with the Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail and Pangani Forest trail for an intimate wildlife walk.
day_by_day.afternoon: Journey to Pandora – The World of Avatar for an otherworldly afternoon. Experience Avatar Flight of Passage (Lightning Lane essential — widely considered the best ride in all of Walt Disney World) — a breathtaking banshee-riding simulator over the bioluminescent landscape of Pandora. Explore Na'vi River Journey and the stunning floating mountains of the Valley of Mo'ara. Grab a Pandoran specialty drink from Pongu Pongu. Take time to explore Discovery Island and the Tree of Life with its intricate animal carvings.
day_by_day.evening: Experience the magical Rivers of Light nighttime spectacular at Animal Kingdom (check schedule, as show times vary). Afterwards, depart for a luxurious private resort dinner experience. Tonight is ideal for an in-resort fine dining reservation or a private chef dinner arranged through your Aegean Bliss concierge.

meals.breakfast: Tiffins Restaurant early breakfast or Tusker House Restaurant character breakfast — Donald's Safari Breakfast features beloved Disney characters in safari attire; a wonderful family memory
meals.lunch: Tiffins Restaurant, Animal Kingdom — Disney's most upscale table-service restaurant inside a park; globally inspired cuisine including whole fried fish, chilled shrimp, and braised short rib; exceptional cocktail and wine program
meals.dinner: Private in-suite chef dinner at Aegean Bliss Resort arranged through the concierge — a bespoke multi-course tasting menu with wine pairings served on your beachfront suite terrace under the stars

day_by_day.notes: Animal Kingdom typically closes earlier than other parks (check hours). Avatar Flight of Passage Lightning Lane should be secured immediately upon park opening. The Tusker House character breakfast requires an ADR 60 days in advance. A private chef dinner at the resort should be arranged at least 48–72 hours ahead through the concierge.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a free and flexible morning at Aegean Bliss Resort. Sleep in, indulge in a champagne brunch by the beachfront pool, or book a couples' spa treatment at the resort's luxury spa (hot stone massage, hydrotherapy circuit, or a signature facial). This is your day to breathe, recharge, and soak in the resort's premium amenities before a fun-filled evening at Disney Springs.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head to Disney Springs for a relaxed and indulgent afternoon of shopping, exploration, and entertainment. Browse luxury boutiques including Vera Bradley, Kate Spade, Alex and Ani, and the massive World of Disney store. Visit the LEGO Imagination Center for younger family members. Explore The Art of Disney gallery for collectibles and original artwork. Enjoy a cocktail at Paradiso 37 or The BOATHOUSE's outdoor deck overlooking the waterfront.
day_by_day.evening: Spend a festive Disney Springs Dining & Entertainment Evening. Enjoy live music from roaming performers and the House of Blues stage. Catch an IMAX film at AMC Disney Springs 24 or visit Splitsville Luxury Lanes for upscale bowling and sushi. Cap the night with a world-class dinner at one of Disney Springs' finest restaurants, then return to the resort for a nightcap.

meals.breakfast: Champagne brunch at the Aegean Bliss Resort beachfront restaurant — eggs royale, lobster frittata, fresh oysters, and bottomless mimosas with ocean views
meals.lunch: The BOATHOUSE, Disney Springs — waterfront dining with fresh seafood; try the lobster roll, crab cakes, or the Captain's Platter; enjoy an Amphicar boat tour of Lake Buena Vista before or after
meals.dinner: Morimoto Asia, Disney Springs — Iron Chef Masaharu Morimoto's flagship restaurant; signature dishes include Peking duck, rock shrimp tempura, and wagyu gyoza; excellent sake and cocktail program; request a private dining room for the family

day_by_day.notes: Disney Springs is free to enter and has no park ticket required — a perfect lower-key day. The BOATHOUSE Amphicar tours are a unique Disney Springs experience and a fun family activity (~$125 per vehicle, up to 3 guests). Morimoto Asia is consistently one of the most popular Disney Springs restaurants — book 60 days in advance. Splitsville requires no reservation but expect waits on busy evenings.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a final luxurious morning at Aegean Bliss Resort. Wake up early for one last sunrise walk along the beachfront. Indulge in a leisurely full breakfast at the resort's signature restaurant. Complete checkout formalities — your concierge will arrange luggage storage so you can enjoy the resort until your transfer time. Take a final dip in the pool or enjoy a mimosa on your balcony while soaking in the views.
day_by_day.afternoon: Depending on your departure flight time, spend your final hours revisiting a favorite Disney park for a few last-minute rides using any remaining Lightning Lane credits, or return to Disney Springs for last-minute souvenir shopping and gift purchasing. Collect any pre-ordered Disney merchandise from the resort gift shop. Arrange your private luxury airport transfer through the resort concierge — allow at least 2.5–3 hours before your flight for Orlando International.
day_by_day.evening: Depart Orlando with unforgettable memories. Your private car service will ensure a smooth, comfortable journey to Orlando International Airport. Enjoy priority check-in and lounge access (United Club if flying UA) before boarding.

meals.breakfast: Grand farewell breakfast at Aegean Bliss Resort's signature waterfront restaurant — full American breakfast with smoked salmon, Belgian waffles, fresh-squeezed juice, and specialty coffee; a fitting send-off
meals.lunch: Light farewell lunch at Disney Springs or a resort café — lobster tacos, a gourmet sandwich, and a final Disney-themed dessert (Mickey-shaped macaron or Dole Whip float)
meals.dinner: Airport dining or in-flight — if departing in the evening, enjoy a meal at the United Club lounge or a restaurant at MCO prior to boarding

day_by_day.notes: Request a late checkout from Aegean Bliss Resort (typically until 2:00 PM for premium suites — confirm with concierge). Pre-arrange all gratuities and final charges to be settled the night before to ensure a smooth morning departure. Consider shipping Disney souvenirs home via the resort's shipping service to avoid luggage hassles. Leave a review and tip your concierge team — they made the magic happen.

query: Disney World Orlando family of 4, $6000, 7 days, June 2026
